thread.title: Bear Market Action Takes A Bite Out Of FAANG Stocks | Investor's Business Daily

author: BRIAN DEAGON
title: Bear Market Action Takes A Bite Out Of FAANG Stocks | Investor's Business Daily
text:
All five of the FAANG stocks were hit Thursday on a bad day in the stock market, as analysts remain concerned about a weakening outlook and other troubles for the technology giants.
X
The FAANG stocks — Facebook ( FB ), Amazon.com ( AMZN ), Apple ( AAPL ), Netflix ( NFLX ) and Google-owner Alphabet ( GOOGL ) — long have been industry darlings, representing the biggest stocks in tech and the internet.
The Nasdaq's fall was driven by a sharp drop in shares among FAANG stocks. This also includes other large tech companies that have led the stock market during its long bull run.
Among the FAANG stocks, Amazon fell 2.3% to close at 1,460.83 on the stock market today . Netflix stock tumbled 2.3% to close at 260.58.

Please contact customer service CLOSE The Nasdaq composite lost 1.6% and officially fell into bear market territory by falling more than 20% from its recent high. The latest round of selling comes a day after the Federal Reserve raised interest rates for a fourth time this year. Wall Street's worries grew Thursday, after the threat of a government shutdown resurfaced.
Shares of Apple skidded 2.5%, to 156.83. Google owner Alphabet dropped 1.1% to 1,023.58.
Facebook, down 2.4% earlier in the day, eked out a 0.1% gain, closing at 133.40.
